limitations: Receptor-complex and Wnt output are cell- and ligand-context dependent; no SCI transfer or terminal TF is inferred. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO1 bound LGR5 and formed a structurally resolved LGR5-RSPO1-RNF43 complex; cell studies confirmed the LGR-family receptor interaction.
limitations: Structural ternary-complex and full-length whole-cell E3-association results are not identical; no universal LGR5 relay or terminal TF is claimed. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO1 bound LGR6 with high affinity in cell-based binding and competition assays; primary receptor studies also placed LGR6 within the RSPO1-4 receptor family.
limitations: The direct study tested human LGR6 and RSPO1-3; migration is a cancer-cell context and no SCI transfer is inferred. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO1 bound RNF43 through its Fu1 motif in cell-based and structural studies; the RSPO1-RNF43 interface was resolved and was compatible with an LGR5-RSPO1-RNF43 complex.
limitations: RNF43 functions as an effector component rather than a standalone classical GPCR; direct and complex-level evidence remain distinct. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO1 bound ZNRF3 through the Fu1 domain in cell-based and structural studies, and the ZNRF3-RSPO1 interface was resolved.
limitations: ZNRF3 is an E3 effector node in a receptor complex; no direct RSPO1-to-TF edge is inferred. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO2 bound LGR5 in receptor-complex and structural studies; Rspo2-Lgr5 localization and dependence were demonstrated at the neuromuscular junction.
limitations: The neuromuscular output is tissue-specific and Wnt-dependent; no SCI transfer or terminal TF is inferred. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO2 bound LGR6 in primary cell-based receptor assays; LGR6 was reported to respond to RSPO1-3 with high affinity.
limitations: The LGR6 paper tested RSPO1-3 collectively for Wnt enhancement; receptor-specific physiologic relevance beyond the assay remains unresolved. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO2 bound RNF43 in structural and cellular studies; human RSPO2 variants altered binding to RNF43 and RNF43 inhibition.
limitations: The LGR-independent branch is a developmental context and should not be collapsed with the LGR4/5/6 ternary-complex mechanism. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO2 bound ZNRF3 through the Fu1 domain in structural and cellular studies; RSPO2 variants altered ZNRF3 binding and Wnt-potentiating activity.
limitations: ZNRF3 is an E3 effector node; direct molecular interaction and downstream developmental phenotype remain separate records. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: The primary R-spondin receptor study reported that RSPO3 binds LGR4 as part of the LGR4-6 receptor family.
limitations: RSPO3 has both LGR-dependent and LGR-independent signaling; no SCI transfer or terminal TF is inferred. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO3 bound LGR5 in the primary R-spondin receptor literature and the Rspo3-Lgr5 axis was functionally resolved in gastric stem-cell models.
limitations: The output is gastric and tissue-specific; direct receptor binding and downstream cell fate remain separate layers. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO3 bound LGR6 in the primary LGR receptor literature; LGR6 was shown to bind and respond to RSPO1-3 with high affinity.
limitations: The LGR6 paper tested RSPO1-3 collectively; physiological relevance beyond the receptor-expressing assay remains unresolved. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: RSPO3 bound syndecan-4 in biochemical and cell-based studies; the complex was linked to clathrin-mediated endocytosis.
limitations: This is a distinct non-LGR/PCP branch and should not be merged with canonical LGR-RNF43 Wnt signaling. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: The extracellular Nogo-66 domain binds a brain-specific leucine-rich-repeat Nogo receptor with high affinity; receptor cleavage removes responsiveness and receptor expression confers Nogo-66 inhibition.
limitations: Nogo-66/domain and RTN4R/NgR1 isoform specificity are explicit; no free-subunit intracellular mechanism is inferred. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: Nogo-A-Delta20 binds S1PR2 through extracellular receptor-loop sites distinct from the S1P pocket; co-IP and receptor-membrane binding supported the interaction, with approximately 142 nM Nogo-A-ext binding in the tested membrane preparation.
limitations: Domain-specific ligand and receptor-containing membrane assay; not a purified free-protein binary affinity measurement. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: Reciprocal BIAcore SPR assays with murine Fc-fusion proteins showed direct SECTM1A–CD7 binding, weaker/differential dissociation relative to SECTM1B, and competition for the CD7-binding context.
limitations: The same primary study identifies GITR as an alternative SECTM1A binder and shows CD7-independent T-cell co-stimulation; direct binding is therefore separate from CD7-specific relay/function attribution. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

species_support: human recombinant proteins; mouse and human cell models
evidence_summary: Recombinant human SFRP2 bound an FZD5-Fc ectodomain in a solid-phase assay with Kd 103 +/- 6 nM, EC50 205 +/- 12 nM, and Hill coefficient 1.9; SFRP2 and FZD5 also co-localized at the endothelial-cell surface and co-immunoprecipitated in endothelial models.
limitations: The affinity measurement used recombinant human SFRP2 and an FZD5-Fc ectodomain, while cell assays used mouse and human endothelial lines. Binding topology is direct for the tested proteins, but no SCI receiver-cell model or injury-state validation was performed. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: The Sonic hedgehog N-terminal domain formed a calcium-dependent complex with the third fibronectin type III repeat of mammalian CDO/CDON; biochemical, biophysical, and X-ray structural studies mapped the interface and showed that disease-associated SHH mutations disrupt receptor interaction.
limitations: The structural paper uses recombinant domains and does not model native SCI receiver cells. CDO/CDON is a ligand-binding coreceptor, and the full-length receptor-complex stoichiometry and lipidated SHH presentation are context dependent. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: Cell-surface binding, in vitro activity, and explant assays identified a specific SHH binding surface for GAS1; the HPE-associated SHH N115K mutation severely reduced SHH/GAS1 binding and signaling activity.
limitations: The study uses cell-surface and recombinant/mutant systems rather than an SCI receiver-cell model. GAS1 is a GPI-linked coreceptor and can act with PTCH1, CDON, BOC, and SCUBE carriers; those complexes are not collapsed into the binary binding edge. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: Recombinant human SLURP-1 selectively bound alpha7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptors in affinity purification and alpha7-overexpressing cells; it did not compete with alpha-bungarotoxin for the classical ligand site.
limitations: Human SLURP-1/alpha7 evidence does not establish a direct intracellular interaction or a universal downstream pathway. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.

evidence_summary: HAI-1/SPINT1 extracellular protein and its Kunitz-1 domain potently inhibited matriptase/ST14 in biochemical and structure-guided studies.
limitations: The interaction is inhibitory and extracellular. No intracellular TF interaction is implied by protease inhibition. High is limited to the tested molecular interaction; no canonical signaling or SCI-context inference is made.
